events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect build folder, slide 2 source and ruled-out tool mentions
events.input: $ git status --short | head -20; ls workshop-plan/build/ | head -50; sed -n 105,130p workshop-plan/build/content.py; grep -n -i -E 'apollo|sendgrid|godaddy|builtwith|neverbounce|zerobounce|instantly' workshop-plan/build/*.py | cut -c1-400

events.name: Bash
events.head: Fetch the Tantra webinar deck and list lines carrying dates

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check done-when grep, served copy parity, live mirror parity, unpushed commits and the proof source text
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git grep -i -c -E 'apollo|sendgrid|godaddy|builtwith|neverbounce|zerobounce|instantly' -- workshop-plan/deck.html; echo "grep rc=$?"; cmp workshop-plan/deck.html app/public/materials/deck.html && echo SAME; grep -c 'Add your own proof point' workshop-plan/deck.html; grep -o 'Growth Idea, webinar #4[^<]*' workshop-plan/deck.html | head -2; git log --oneline -6 -- workshop-plan/deck.html workshop-plan/build/content.py; git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tail -1; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD | wc -l; git diff --stat origin/main HEAD -- workshop-plan/dec

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run both deck probes and check the coordination log for holds
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; (node workshop-plan/probe-deck.mjs 2>&1 | tail -6); (node workshop-plan/probe-deck-nav.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4); grep -n -i 'hold\|held' ~/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md 2>/dev/null | tail -5

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the deck commit is already on the remote
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git merge-base --is-ancestor bd9b0f6 origin/main && echo "deck commit ON origin" || echo "deck commit NOT on origin"; git diff --quiet origin/main HEAD -- workshop-plan/deck.html app/public/materials/deck.html workshop-plan/build/content.py workshop-plan/build/lanes.py workshop-plan/build/questions.py workshop-plan/build/generate.py && echo "deck files identical on origin"; git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Set the task to review with evidence and acknowledge the note
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; V=$(date +%s); python3 workshop-plan/tasks/pass.py set T-021 status=review needs_from_owner="" note="Repeat Orchestrator note: both items were already finished and live. Slide 2 carries the Growth Idea, webinar #4, August 2025 result word for word from the Tantra webinar deck, and no ruled-out tool is named. Rechecked now: the done-when grep returns nothing, probe-deck is clean on all 158 slides, probe-deck-nav passes, and the live mirror is byte-identical to the source and to origin main, so nothing needed pushing. Open the deck link to approve." evi

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check why the acknowledgement reported zero
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -c 'F-5fade61c' workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl; grep 'F-5fade61c' workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl | python3 -c "

events.name: Bash
events.head: Commit the task board update
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git add -- workshop-plan/tasks/tasks.json && git commit -q -m "Agent T-021: repeat Orchestrator note, both deck items already live, grep and probes rechecked, mirror matches source, task stays in review

events.text: T-021 stays in review: both deck items were already finished and live, so this run only rechecked them (done-when grep empty, both probes clean, live mirror byte-identical to source, nothing left to push); note F-5fade61c was already acknowledged, and the deck awaits Adi's approval at https://adisuja.github.io/tantra-workshop-live/deck.html.
